name: Zhiwen Cao
about: Welcome! I’m Zhiwen Cao (曹智文). I am currently a Ph.D. candidate in the School of Computer Science at Sichuan University, advised by [Prof. Shudong Huang (黄树东)](https://huangsd.github.io/). I obtained my M.S. degree in the School of Information Science and Engineering at Ningbo University, where I was very fortunate to be advised by [Prof. Xijiong Xie (谢锡炯)](https://machinelearningnbu.github.io/).
interests: My research interests include machine learning and its applications in computer vision, with a current focus on continual learning and multimodal large language models.
